findings.risk: Using HTTP instead of HTTPS allows for man-in-the-middle attacks and data interception.
findings.remediation: Change the protocol to HTTPS for both instance and load balancer ports. Add SSL certificate ARN to the listener block.

findings.risk: Weak health check configuration can lead to false positives or negatives, affecting the availability and reliability of the application.
findings.remediation: Increase the healthy_threshold and unhealthy_threshold values to ensure more reliable health checks.

findings.risk: A very high idle timeout value can lead to resource wastage and potential security risks due to prolonged connections.
findings.remediation: Reduce the idle_timeout value to a more reasonable duration, such as 60 seconds.
